candidates.prompt:
Create one production-ready square seamless TILEABLE game ALBEDO / BASE COLOR texture of an aged ceramic tile exterior facade in a cat-world rainy cyberpunk miniature city. Completely flat orthographic front view, square image filled edge to edge by only the ceramic surface. Detailed environmental surface art. All lighting will be computed by the game engine: absolutely even diffuse color, no directional bevel highlights, no specular glaze glare, no shadows around chips, no vignette, no broad brightness gradient, no baked neon color or light. Dirt and chips are material-color details only. Grid periodicity is critical: exactly 8 columns and 8 rows of complete equally sized square tiles. All four image boundaries cut through the CENTER of the same very thin neutral gray grout joint; each boundary contains only half of a grout line, so two copies meet to make one normal interior line. All internal grout lines evenly spaced at 12.5%, 25%, 37.5%, 50%, 62.5%, 75%, 87.5%, with edges at 0% and 100%. Outer and inner grout joints have identical narrow width and flat color. NO doubled seam or extra sliver of a tile. Keep grout subdued, without a painted illuminated lip or black outline. All surface wear stays inside tiles; avoid cracks or stains crossing image boundaries. Distribute tiny stains and wear evenly without one recognizable hero patch. The entire texture must repeat naturally on both axes, without a frame. No perspective, room, building, object, text, graffiti, logo, people, cats, faces, material sphere, border, panel labels or preview montage. Deliver one full-resolution 1024x1024 square albedo texture, not a 2x2 preview.
VARIANT: old muted seafoam-green ceramic facade. Pale desaturated blue-green matte glaze, occasional slightly grayer replacement tiles, fine crazing, sparse little glaze chips that expose warm gray ceramic, smoke dust concentrated subtly along grout. Cool dirty gray grout, controlled mid-light values. A restrained clean grid with believable age. No pooled wet reflections.
candidates.selection_note: 未采用；AI 修订连续亮边、灰缝边界后再检查平铺。

candidates.prompt: Refine the supplied ceramic facade image into a completely UNLIT, seamless, periodic ALBEDO / BASE COLOR texture for a game. Keep its same material, palette, 8 by 8 equal-size square tile layout, naturally varied replacement tile colors, tiny ceramic glaze chips, fine crazing and distributed grime. Preserve crisp original texture detail. Correct two technical issues: (1) remove the continuous white top/left rim streaks and dark bottom/right bevel shading that look like relief lighting. Tile chips and mortar should have flat material colors, without a bright edge or a shadow side. No specular shine, rim lighting, drop shadows, ambient occlusion painted around tile edges, vignette, or global illumination gradient. The engine will light the tiles. (2) the FOUR image boundaries must lie through the CENTER of a thin flat mortar joint, each showing only HALF a normal interior joint width. These boundary joints must have the same uniform neutral-gray color as each other and the internal mortar joints; no extra frame or tile sliver. Exactly eight complete square tile columns and rows fit the full square, with all inner mortar lines evenly spaced at 12.5% intervals. The left/right and top/bottom edge features must continue when repeated, with one normal joint at each repetition seam. Avoid unique big wear marks, and keep micro-wear away from outer mortar joints. Fill the full square edge to edge, orthographic front view of only a flat surface. No perspective, objects, words, logos, faces, neon, preview montage or border. One 1024x1024 game albedo texture.
candidates.selection_note: 采用；去除连续亮边并修正物理灰缝边界，完整周期降采样。
